sentences.en: Presented are methods of isolation of pili and pilus-like structures from Gram-positive bacteria including Streptococcus pneumoniae and compositions that include such isolated pili.

sentences.en: The relationship of K88 pili, enterotoxin, hemolysin and epidemiology of piglet colibacillosis was discussed in this paper.

sentences.en: When were hairier (see No. 9), the erector pili made the hairs stand on end when we needed to appear bigger and scarier. Now, it just gives us goose bumps.

sentences.en: In this depiction of the rod-shaped E. coli, two flagella trail from one end while hairlike pili surround a capsule full of tangled nucleoids.

sentences.en: The portion of the follicle between the sebaceous duct and the insertion of the arrector pili muscle is the isthmus.
